scope_lock.objective: Independently decide whether commit ab5ca87556 implements the complete audit-derived checklist and closes the repeated first-missing-file loop before any runtime side effect.
required_review: Verify the exact seven-file diff and every immutable evidence hash.
Recompute the real retained-checkout result and require all 13 audited missing identities plus missing native extraction provenance in one receipt.
Trace each manifest class to the audit and production consumer, including exact-file, bounded-pattern, complete-directory, DVC, DataDir, bundle, snapshot, symlink, and no-follow behavior.
Determine whether complete-directory drift can identify every missing or extra member, rather than only an aggregate count or hash mismatch.
Determine whether a committed audit hash is actually verified or merely syntax-checked.

Trace capture setup, static readback, and live validation from their normal generated command paths. Decide whether runtime_asset_closure_not_requested leaves any supported raid or dungeon path able to reach a downstream side effect without the checklist.
Require failure before nav probing, contract materialization/database access, provisioning, output creation, or worldserver launch.
Check that map selection is generic, no Magmaw exception exists, legacy compatibility does not weaken the new mandatory safety property, and no copied asset is required by implicit cwd.
Run the authorized focused tests and add read-only probes where needed.

severity_policy.critical: The verifier can authorize a materially incomplete or substituted native/offline asset closure.
severity_policy.high: A normal supported launch/readback path can bypass the gate, or the verifier cannot enumerate the complete mismatch set required to prevent repeat retries.
severity_policy.medium: A required identity or provenance binding is incomplete but does not directly authorize launch in the reviewed path.
severity_policy.low: A bounded clarity or coverage gap with no current gate impact.

acceptance_conditions: Return GO only with no unresolved critical, high, or medium findings.
A GO proves every supported production path fails closed on incomplete closure without relying on an operator remembering optional arguments.
A GO proves aggregate reports identify every missing and extra member for all rule types and bind the exact audit/provenance authority.
A NO-GO names the earliest violated property, exact code and test locations, smallest correction ownership, and deterministic acceptance test.
scope_lock.allowed_mutation: Create only the external review handoff at owned_output.
forbidden_changes: No asset copy or hydration, DVC operation, database access, provisioning, build, capture, worldserver start, or live canary.
No gameplay, encounter, class, role, roster, or movement recommendation outside the reviewed checklist boundary.
required_commands: pixi run python -m py_compile tools/raid_program/runtime_asset_closure.py tools/raid_program/capture_setup.py tools/raid_program/capture_phase1_provisioning_readback.py tools/bot_ml/run_live_bot_validation.py

terminal_conditions.success: Write a hash-verified external GO handoff with no unresolved critical, high, or medium finding.
terminal_conditions.failure: Write a hash-verified external NO-GO handoff with bounded correction ownership and stop.
terminal_conditions.out_of_scope: Report adjacent hydration or live concerns without acting on them.

next_action: Dispatch one independent Sol high raid-shard-architecture reviewer. Correct any NO-GO before hydration or live validation.
